firstPlayerRule: Everyone spins the spinner. The player spinning the highest number plays first, and the others follow from left to right.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest spin, those players spin again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Winning Moves-hosted rules PDF listed on winning-moves.com/rules/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "Spin the spinner to see who starts the game. The player spinning the highest number plays first. Other players follow in turn from left to right."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high spins.
